criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Card Payment Issue
categories.definition: Queries related to issues with card payments, such as being charged extra, payment not going through, or card not being accepted.

categories.name: Account Management
categories.definition: Questions about managing accounts, such as changing personal details, opening accounts for children, or reporting address changes.

categories.name: Transaction Discrepancy
categories.definition: Concerns about discrepancies in transactions, such as being charged multiple times for the same transaction or not receiving the correct amount.

categories.name: Card Activation/Replacement
categories.definition: Queries related to activating new cards, ordering replacements for lost or stolen cards, or cancelling transactions.

categories.name: Top-Up Issues
categories.definition: Issues related to topping up accounts, such as pending top-ups, verification codes missing, or top-ups not working.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Questions about verifying identity for account security purposes.

categories.name: Transfer Troubleshooting
categories.definition: Queries related to troubleshooting transfers, such as transfers not going through, delays in transfers, or incorrect recipient details.

categories.name: Currency Exchange
categories.definition: Questions about currency exchange rates, fees, and options for holding different currencies.

categories.name: Card Delivery
categories.definition: Queries related to card delivery, such as tracking card shipments, delivery times, or delays in receiving cards.

categories.name: Contactless Payment Issue
categories.definition: Concerns about contactless payment not working or being declined.

categories.name: ATM Troubleshooting
categories.definition: Issues related to ATM transactions, such as incorrect amounts dispensed, fees charged, or PIN changes.

categories.name: Virtual Card Inquiry
categories.definition: Questions about virtual cards, such as limits on usage, activation, or obtaining disposable virtual cards.

categories.name: Refund Request
categories.definition: Requests for refunds due to unauthorized transactions, duplicate charges, or incorrect amounts.

categories.name: Account Closure
categories.definition: Requests to close accounts due to dissatisfaction with services or other reasons.

categories.name: Payment Decline
categories.definition: Queries about declined payments, reasons for payment cancellations, or pending payments.

categories.name: Cash Withdrawal Issue
categories.definition: Concerns related to cash withdrawals, such as incorrect amounts received, fees charged, or pending withdrawals.

categories.name: Card Security
categories.definition: Queries related to card security, such as blocking cards, unblocking PINs, or reporting lost or stolen cards.

categories.name: International Transactions
categories.definition: Questions about international transactions, fees, exchange rates, and card usage abroad.

categories.name: Child Account Inquiry
categories.definition: Inquiries about opening accounts for children, age requirements, and account management for minors.

categories.name: Payment Verification
categories.definition: Queries about verifying payments, sources of funds, or identity for security purposes.
